name: LM7805
description: Fixed 5V three-terminal linear regulator from the 78xx family. Simple and rugged. TO-220 pin order is IN-GND-OUT. The 78xx series offers other voltages (7809=9V, 7812=12V).

TO-220.notes: metal tab is connected to GND, so it can share a grounded heatsink safely.

typical_application: Add 0.33uF on the input and 0.1uF on the output close to the pins. Input must be at least ~7V for a stable 5V out.
gotchas: linear: dissipates (Vin - 5) * Iload as heat; a 12V input at 500mA wastes 3.5W, needs a heatsink
the TAB is GND on the 78xx (opposite of the LM317 whose tab is OUT)
needs the input/output decoupling caps or it can oscillate
minimum ~2V dropout; will not regulate from a nearly-flat 5V source
